brief: Two pairs of bases. Bolt the two bases of each pair together, with no connector inside a pair. Put the pairs side by side and fit a side connector on every wall where one pair touches the other.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full held by jointBolt:0#0,0#0 (plus lockJoints bolt); piece:2,0,0;full + piece:3,0,0;full held by jointBolt:0#3,0#3. Topology shows groups [0,0 1,0] and [2,0 3,0].
Each pair has joint bolt(s) and its internal wall is bare (0,0|1,0 bare, 2,0|3,0 bare) with no connector part inside either pair.

finish.summary: Built 4 bases in a row as two pairs (0,0-1,0 and 2,0-3,0), each pair joint-bolted with bare internal wall, and a single side connector on the one wall where the pairs touch. capOpenFaces + lockJoints applied; check_build ok, meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-single  (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-single (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
